name: patronly
description: Runs the Patronly frontend and backend together.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run setup:api
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.lint: cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check . && .venv/bin/ruff format --check . && cd ../frontend && npx prettier --check src e2e
